name: Pechkas
summary: Mobile repair shop desk: IMEI job cards, a drag-and-drop repair board, parts stock and daily cash
about: A workshop app for a Pakistani phone repair shop. Open job cards with a checked IMEI, fault and estimate, move phones across the board from Received to Delivered, keep screens, batteries and ports in stock with low-stock alerts, and close the day with a cash report in PKR. Built for repair counters in any mobile market.
how: Click New job: enter the customer, model, a 15-digit IMEI (the check digit is verified), fault, estimate and advance, and tick what came with the phone.
On the Job board, drag a card from Received to Diagnosing, Waiting for part, Ready or Delivered, or use its move button for a keyboard menu.
Moving to Ready asks for the part used (it leaves stock) and labour; moving to Delivered collects the balance and adds it to the cash report.
Open a job to see the phone scan with the faulty part glowing, its history, print a job slip, or tap Tell customer to open a ready WhatsApp text (wa.me link).
Parts stock flags low and out-of-stock lines; Daily cash adds accessory sales and expenses and checks the counted drawer.
The Bench page shows the phone being diagnosed now with a live bench timer, the shop floor, turnaround and what breaks most.
